user.title: Add a charge point
user.description: How do you want to find the charge point?

id.title: Charge point ID
id.description:
Enter the EVSE ID of the charge point, as printed on the charger or shown in your charging app, for example `NL*TNM*EGL31*1*1049*07*1`. Punctuation and case do not matter and the socket number at the end may be left out. A DOT-NL location ID such as `NL-TNM-231` works too.

The lookup searches the national dataset and can take up to a minute.

map.title: Find a charge point
map.description: Move the marker to the area where the charge point is and adjust the circle. All public charge points in that area are listed in the next step (search radius is capped at 2 km).

select.title: Choose a charge point
select.description: Add the integration again to follow more charge points.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the DOT-NL API. Try again later.
error.no_charge_points: No new charge points found in this area. Move the marker or enlarge the circle.
error.invalid_id: Enter at least 8 letters or digits of the ID.
error.id_not_found: No public charge point with this ID was found in the DOT-NL dataset. Check the ID or search on the map instead.

abort.already_configured: This charge point is already configured.

init.title: Options
init.description: How often the availability is fetched from DOT-NL.
